description: This file defines an interface 'MatcherProcessorInterface' within the namespace 'Goteo\Util\MatcherProcessor'. It declares methods for implementing a matcher processing logic related to campaigns, matchers, projects, investments, payment methods, and event listeners in the Goteo project. The interface specifies the structure for classes that will handle matcher processing functionalities including setup, retrieval, and event registration.

classes.name: MatcherProcessorInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for matcher processor classes, including methods for retrieving information, managing context objects like matcher, project, invest, payment method, and obtaining event listeners.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this processor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a friendly name for this processor.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the processor's rules.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the processor handles a specific matcher campaign.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the processor for the specified matcher.

methods.name: getVarLabels
methods.description: Returns an array of custom variable labels used by the processor.

methods.name: getVars
methods.description: Retrieves the current custom variables for this processor.

methods.name: setMatcher
methods.description: Associates a Matcher object with the processor.

methods.name: getMatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the matcher associated with this processor.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total amount to be added, providing error reason if zero.

methods.name: getInvests
methods.description: Returns a list of investments corresponding to the total amount.

methods.name: getAppEventListeners
methods.description: Provides event listeners for application runtime, conforming to Symfony event system.

methods.name: getConsoleEventListeners
methods.description: Provides event listeners for console (cron) triggers, similar to app event listeners.
